current.summary: The staircase runs the full height of the house and changes character as it climbs. Entrance hall: narrow, with the old brown panelled front door (smart lock, fanlight above), terracotta tiles laid diagonally, and a brown door to the ground-floor room. Coats and a cabinet currently fill one side. Lower flights: speckled terrazzo steps and landings; an old painted meter cupboard in the wall. Middle flights: white-grey marble treads. Upper flights: dark stone or slate treads. Landings: one in terrazzo with an arched niche holding an iron fleur-de-lis grille and an urn; one in beautiful old patterned cement tiles (star and lattice design) with a small octagonal window. A wrought-iron scroll balustrade runs all the way up. Walls are cream, with a black-painted skirting band following the stairs, and black lantern-style wall lights at each level. The walls show the recent pipe and cable work: long grey filler patches (pencilled “TUBI” and “2 TUBI 25” where pipes run), white access covers, green tape remnants at ceiling lines, cracks, and peeling paint with old blue-green paint underneath near the top.
keep: Wrought-iron scroll balustrade — the best feature of the stair
Old meter cupboard door (as a period detail)
issues: Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Walls: fill and sand the pipe-run patches, cracks and peeling areas, then repaint the whole stairwell in one go (about 12 m high — needs a stair scaffold/tower)
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Photograph or sketch where the pipes run (the “TUBI” marks) before painting over them — you will want to know later
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Remove tape remnants; paint or replace the white access covers so they disappear
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Loose cable hanging on the wall above the patterned-tile landing
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Black skirting band: repaint crisply, or change colour
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Lantern lights give cold white light — change to warm bulbs (2700K)
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Balustrade: clean, treat rust, repaint black
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Treads and landings: deep clean; polish marble; repair the patched inset on the marble landing
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Entrance hall: coats, shoes and stored items on the stairs and landings — needs proper hooks, a slim bench and shoe storage
Proposed by Claude (not yet agreed): Front door: restore and repaint

target.concept: DRAFT — the staircase is the spine of the house and already has the character: iron scrollwork, marble, terrazzo, old cement tiles. Finish the walls in one warm white from bottom to top so those features stand out, keep the dark skirting band as a crisp graphic line, warm the lighting, and give the entrance a proper place for coats and shoes.
